header: A live wall of headline cards, each one a roller in the manner of a departure board: I made it keep itself current, and the screen never jumps.

- One story, one card. A card is a story (src/lib/live/rss.ts, mergeFeeds): the same event from several papers is one card, shown under the identity of the FIRST report and by the LATEST headline, with the other papers named. Cards are ordered by when their story began, newest first, and a card never changes its place when its story develops.

- A card turns like a drum about an axis behind it. When its story develops (another paper adds a later headline) THAT card alone rolls: the old headline turns up and away, the new one turns in from below, and the card says "Updated" and where the story began. A new story rolls in at the top, the others gliding down a card's height; a story that leaves rolls away. On first showing, the cards roll in one after another. I stagger several rolling at once 140 ms apart, never together, and only transforms and opacity move (smooth, no layout shifts).
- Every card has the same height (two lines of headline, three on a phone; the whole headline is in its tooltip), so a roll never changes the size of anything around it.

- While you are READING (the pointer is over the list, a link has the keyboard focus, or you have scrolled down) I HOLD arrivals and developments, so that nothing turns under your hand: a small pill, "2 new · 1 updated", floats at the top (taking no room in the list); click it, or take the pointer away at the top, and the cards roll.
- Times ("12 min ago") tick on their own every 15 seconds. Reduced-motion users get the same cards with a plain fade and no turning.
The data and their refresh belong to the card (NewsCard.tsx, useLive); this component only shows them. Nothing typed is sent anywhere.

symbols.name: planRefresh
symbols.sig: export function planRefresh<T extends FeedItem>(shown: T[], items: T[], reading: boolean): Plan<T>
doc: What to do when a refresh arrives, as a plain decision: nothing (the same cards), hold it (someone is reading and there are new stories or developments, so I say how many), or take it in (nobody is reading). A refresh that only removes stories, or only changes which papers are named, also waits for a moment of no reading, so that nothing changes under the hand.

symbols.name: pillText
symbols.sig: export function pillText(added: number, changed: number): string
doc: "↑ 2 new stories", "↻ 1 updated story", "↑ 2 new · 1 updated"

symbols.name: Delays
doc: The seconds each rolling card waits, by the link of the headline it shows: cards that roll together are staggered, in the order of the wall.

symbols.name: rollVariants
symbols.sig: export function rollVariants(link: string, calm: boolean)
doc: The roll of a card: it turns about an axis behind it, in from below and out upward; with reduced motion I use a plain fade.

behaviours: the same stories: nothing happens, reading or not
arrivals while nobody reads: taken in, naming the new ones (n1, n2)
arrivals while someone reads: HELD, with the count (2 new, 0 updated)
a refresh that only removes stories waits while someone reads, and is taken in when nobody does
a first fill of an empty list is all arrivals
a story whose headline changed (same story, a later paper's headline) is CHANGED, not new: applied at once when nobody reads
a development while someone reads is HELD, counted as updated (0 new, 1 updated)
the same story with only another paper named is taken in quietly when nobody reads, and ignored while someone does
the pill says what is waiting: '↑ 2 new stories', '↻ 1 updated story', '↑ 2 new · 1 updated'
a card is 'updated' when the headline shown is not the story's first report
a card turns like a drum: in from below (rotateX 90 to 0) and out upward (0 to -90), each waiting the stagger it was given, by its own link
with reduced motion the card only fades: no rotation in any of its states
cards that roll together are one beat apart (0.14 s), the first showing one after another (0.07 s)
recent means under 30 minutes at the moment of looking; no time, no claim
a paper's chip colour is always the same for the same name
rows: each headline, its paper and its time; no row numbers
every link opens in a NEW TAB with noopener noreferrer, and nothing but http(s) links
the page language is set on the list, and an empty list says so
a story several papers carried is ONE row from the first, naming the others: 'also in Times of India, Hindustan Times'; a story of one paper names none
a developed card says Updated and where the story began ('first reported by Hindustan Times ...') and also names the third paper; the 'also in' line is only for cards that have not developed

every card has the same fixed height (a slot of 108 px on a phone, 88 px otherwise) and clamps its headline to three lines on a phone, two otherwise, with the whole headline in its tooltip, so a roll never resizes anything
on first showing the cards start turned away (rotateX 90) and roll in, each card in its own perspective, hinged on an axis behind it
a curated card shows NO chip of what kind of news it is, no red edge and no desk name: only the headline, the paper and the time (the desk only chooses and orders the stories)
the Bengali tab explains its curation on the card (a front page of several Bengali dailies, Anandabazar first, what comes first)
a screen-reader line says how many came in, politely, and the list itself is not a live region (a whole list read out at every refresh would be noise)
nothing is held at the start, so no pill is drawn
the clock is to the second, in Indian time: 06:40:10 UTC is 12:10:10 pm
the modes: live, paused (by hand, wins over a failure), not updating (a failed check)
live: LIVE, the time of the figures, a countdown, Pause and Check now
paused: PAUSED, Resume, and no countdown
failed check: NOT UPDATING, 'Last update', and the plain sentence that it will try again by itself
a card is keyed by its headline (a development is a new face in the same place) and animates only its own arrival, development and departure (popLayout, position layout), with reduced motion honoured
reading is hover (of a mouse), focus in the list, or scrolled away from the top; arrivals are held then
the pill takes no room (a zero-height sticky holder), so it can never move a row
times and chips are re-read by a clock of 15 seconds, and that clock is cleaned up
the refresh is QUIET: a timer, only while the page is visible, no loading state, a failure sets lagging and keeps what is shown; there is still ONE fetch in the hook
the quiet refresh is cleaned up when the card closes or the tab changes
the news card asks every minute (the route keeps one answer for a minute), pauses by hand, shows only the open tab's answer, and never swaps the list for a loading box on refresh
the route keeps one answer for a minute (two for the Bengali tab, with its eleven feeds), and each feed on its own, so that one that fails for a moment gives its last good answer
